### Q6. NTA Abhyas (JEE Main) 2020

*Type:* `singleCorrect` | *Level:* `1`

**Options:**

- **(A)** Sodium
- **(B)** Neutral <math><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>
- **(C)** Phthalic anhydride/conc. <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>
- **(D)** <math> <mrow>  <msub>   <mrow>    <mtext>Br</mtext></mrow>   <mtext>2</mtext>  </msub>  <msub>   <mrow>    <mtext>/H</mtext></mrow>   <mtext>2</mtext>  </msub>  <mtext>O</mtext></mrow></math>

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(A) Sodium**

**Detailed Solution:**

With neutral <math> <mrow> <msub> <mrow> <mtext>FeCl</mtext></mrow> <mtext>3</mtext> </msub> </mrow> </math> solution, phenol gives violet colour solution but <math> <mrow> <msub> <mrow> <mtext>CH</mtext></mrow> <mtext>3</mtext> </msub> <msub> <mrow> <mtext>CH</mtext></mrow> <mtext>2</mtext> </msub> <mtext>OH</mtext></mrow> </math> does not give this test.
<math> <mrow> <mtable> <mtr> <mtd> <mn>6</mn> <msub> <mtext>C</mtext> <mn>6</mn> </msub> <msub> <mtext>H</mtext> <mn>5</mn> </msub> <mtext>OH</mtext> </mtd> <mtd> <mo>+</mo> </mtd> <mtd> <msub> <mtext>FeCl</mtext> <mn>3</mn> </msub> </mtd> <mtd> <mo>→</mo> </mtd> <mtd> <msup> <mrow> <mfenced close="]" open="[" separators=","> <mrow> <mtext>Fe</mtext> <msub> <mrow> <mfenced close=")" open="(" separators=","> <mrow> <mtext>O</mtext> <msub> <mtext>C</mtext> <mn>6</mn> </msub> <msub> <mtext>H</mtext> <mn>5</mn> </msub> </mrow> </mfenced> </mrow> <mn>6</mn> </msub> </mrow> </mfenced> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mo>-</mo> </mrow> </msup> </mtd> <mtd> <mo>+</mo> </mtd> <mtd> <mn>3</mn> <mrow> <msup> <mtext>H</mtext> <mo>+</mo> </msup> </mrow> </mtd> <mtd> <mo>+</mo> </mtd> <mtd> <mn>3</mn> <mtext>HCl</mtext> </mtd> </mtr> <mtr> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> <mtext>Violet colour complex</mtext> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> <mtd> </mtd> </mtr> </mtable> </mrow> </math>
Phthalic anhydride/Conc.<math> <mrow> <msub> <mtext>H</mtext> <mtext>2</mtext> </msub> <msub> <mrow> <mtext>SO</mtext></mrow> <mtext>4</mtext> </msub> </mrow> </math> and <math> <mrow> <mtext>NaOH</mtext></mrow> </math>

Phenol cannot be distinguished from ethanol by sodium because both evolve hydrogen with sodium.
<math><mn>2</mn><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo><mn>2</mn><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>↑</mo></math>

**Correct Value:** **6.00**

**Detailed Solution:**

Electrophile attack where the electron density high.which shows +M or +I effects are ortho/para directing because they increase electron density at ortho and para +M   <math><mo>-</mo><mover><mrow><mtext>N</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>•</mo><mtext> </mtext><mo>•</mo></mrow></mover><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mo>-</mo><mover><mrow><mtext>N</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>•</mo><mtext> </mtext><mo>•</mo></mrow></mover><mo>=</mo><mtext>O</mtext><mo>,</mo></math> <img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/nta_abhyas/jee_main/images/db2a5b5c-6149-4815-90e3-6f454858219e.png" style="width:0.98792in;height:0.4649in" />, <img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/nta_abhyas/jee_main/images/04cbbb60-08bb-433a-a900-0de695221e9c.png" style="width:1in;height:0.41772in" />, <img alt="" src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/nta_abhyas/jee_main/images/rqwetrgsdfas.png" style="width: 150px; height: 33px;" />
The following groups are meta directing <img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/nta_abhyas/jee_main/images/65f275be-4b3f-47a9-b974-938dff73d9b8.png" style="width:0.57297in;height:0.45755in" /> ,<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/nta_abhyas/jee_main/images/78606ebd-234d-459b-be82-45afba3611eb.png" style="width:0.58977in;height:0.43844in" />, <math><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> They decreases electron density at ortho/para so, electrophile attack at meta position.

</details>
